versions.name: Constricting Darkness
versions.text: Starts at 5 counters. After an ally Titan Spawn dies during the enemy turn, lose 2 counters (once per turn). Turn end: If your board isn't full, gain a counter and summon a Titan Spawn with ATK and HP equal to the counters. If this has 0 counters, disable this instead. If this has 8 counters, begin The Roaring.
